visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair tied in a white scrunchie, wearing a beige sports bra and white leggings, sits on a black weight bench in a gym. She reaches for a cable row handle, gripping it with both hands as she prepares for the exercise. The background features gym equipment, including resistance bands hanging on the wall and an air conditioning unit above. (2) She performs seated cable rows, pulling the handle toward her torso and then extending her arms forward. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her muscle engagement. After completing several repetitions, she stands up, picking up her water bottle and walking out of the frame. (3) The scene cuts to a different angle where she is seated at a lat pulldown machine. She reaches up, grabs the wide bar, and pulls it down toward her upper chest in a controlled motion, showcasing her back muscles. The camera remains static throughout the sequence.
